categories.main_business_segments: Veralto operates through two primary business segments: Water Quality (WQ) and Product Quality & Innovation (PQI). The WQ segment provides water analytics and treatment solutions, while the PQI segment offers marking, coding, packaging, and color management solutions for consumer packaged goods and industrial products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary precision instrumentation, advanced water treatment technologies, chemical reagents, digital solutions, and software (including SaaS and term-based licenses) in WQ. In PQI, it utilizes marking and coding systems, packaging design software, color management tools, and related consumables. Continuous improvement and lean methodologies are embedded through the Veralto Enterprise System (VES).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Veralto serves a broad range of customers, including municipal and private water utilities, industrial companies, food and beverage producers, pharmaceutical firms, and consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies. Its solutions are critical in regulated industries where safety, quality, and traceability are paramount.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with 47% of 2023 sales from North America, 22% from Western Europe, 2% from other developed markets (Japan, Australia, New Zealand), and 29% from high-growth markets (Eastern Europe, Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and Asia excluding Japan, Australia, and New Zealand). Veralto has facilities in over 40 countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Veralto primarily operates downstream in the supply chain, providing finished products, consumables, software, and services directly to end-users and customers. It also supports recurring sales through its large installed base of equipment and instruments.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing sustainability, expanding in high-growth markets, continuous product innovation, and digital transformation. R&D focuses on new product development, enhancing existing offerings, and expanding software and digital solutions, with significant investments in both organic growth and acquisitions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of product sales (equipment and consumables), recurring sales (consumables, spare parts, services, and software), and to a lesser extent, leasing and government contracts. Approximately 59% of 2023 sales were recurring in nature.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Veralto faces intense competition from both large diversified companies and specialized regional players. While no single competitor matches its full product and service breadth, the company holds leadership positions in many of its served markets, competing on innovation, quality, service, and brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Veralto generated $5.0 billion in sales, with a workforce of approximately 16,000 employees. The company achieved 3.1% total sales growth and 2.6% core sales growth year-over-year, with strong operating margins (22.7%) and a resilient recurring revenue base. Net earnings for 2023 were $839 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Veralto emphasizes safeguarding vital resources through innovative, reliable, and regulatory-compliant solutions that ensure water quality, product safety, and consumer trust. Its differentiation lies in its scientific expertise, strong brands, large installed base, recurring revenue model, and a culture of continuous improvement driven by the Veralto Enterprise System.
